name: Remedial Health
long_description: Remedial Health sells medicine wholesale to the 1 million pharmacies and hospitals in Africa. Today in Africa, pharmacies shop in open-air medicine markets where they pay higher prices for counterfeits medicines. We offer a managed marketplace with all the stock they'll need, deliver within 24 hours and offer credit to help them grow.
one_liner: B2B E-commerce & Fintech platform for Pharmacies & Hospitals in Africa

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Pharmacist (Masters in pharmacy) and Software engineer (Self-taught age 14). Started 3 companies and exited 2 whilst at university. Currently the Founder and CEO of Remedial Health - improving affordability and access to medicines by providing direct to retail medical and non-medical consumables from manufacturers to pharmacies in Africa.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder Remedial Health 
A salesman by passion, with a well established background of over 10years in pharma sales. My drive and strategy has earned me several awards as best salesman and distributor back to back for over 4 years at my previous work place.
I bring my experience and strategy to grow sales, increase revenue generation and geographical expansion at Remedial Health.
